prompt:
# approach-dark

Use case: section illustration on a corporate website (Japanese one-person tech company), placed above a three-step "how we work" list: 1) hear the idea, 2) narrow down what to build first, 3) build it and look at it together.
Asset type: wide decorative 3D render, no text.
Aspect ratio: 12:5 (render at 2400x1000 or the closest wide size).

Style/medium: premium abstract 3D render in the manner of modern developer-product websites (Linear, Vercel). Physically based materials, studio lighting, shallow depth of field, very clean.
Color palette: background is a flat, uniform near-black blue #0b0d12 that fills every edge of the frame so the image blends seamlessly into a page of that exact color (no vignette, no gradient frame, no border). Objects in graphite, smoked glass and brushed dark aluminium. One accent color only: soft electric blue light (#5478ff to #7fa2ff), used as rim light and an inner glow.

Subject (left to right, three objects on one invisible floor, evenly spaced, reading as one transformation):

1. Left: a rough, irregular lump of raw dark stone-like material, matte, a few loose fragments around it. Unformed.
2. Center: the same mass partly cut into a cleaner block; one side still rough, the other side faceted with precise planar cuts; faint thin blue construction lines float around it like a measurement grid.
3. Right: a finished, smooth, rounded rectangular slab of smoked glass and aluminium standing upright, with a calm blue light glowing from inside its top edge. It looks like a working, finished product.
   A thin, barely visible line of blue light runs along the floor connecting the three, left to right.

Composition/framing: objects occupy the middle 70% horizontally and sit slightly below the vertical center; generous empty background around them; camera at eye level, slightly elevated; subtle soft reflections on the floor that fade to the background color.

Text: none. No letters, numbers, logos, UI, icons or watermarks anywhere.
Constraints: no people, no hands, no faces. No cream, beige or warm tones. Background must be the exact flat #0b0d12 at all four edges.
Avoid: neon cyberpunk, glowing circuit boards, robots, brains, lightbulbs, rockets, gears, isometric clip art, stock-photo look, purple-pink gradients, lens flares.

Post-process: cropped to 1600x560 (top trimmed) and edges feathered into the page background color.
